row.evidence: Tipalti documents SAML/OIDC SSO and manual or CSV user management in Team management ('You can add your users one by one or import your whole team in one go'), with no SCIM endpoint in its help centre or API.
row.notes: No SCIM found: help-centre search for 'scim' and 'provisioning' returns no relevant articles, the REST API scopes cover payees, payments, invoices and reference data only, and Tipalti is not in the Okta OIN or the Entra Learn tutorial list. Pricing is flat platform pricing with unlimited users (Accounts Payable from $99/month, Mass Payments from $249/month, plus transaction fees; custom quotes), so per-user fields are null. SAML/SSO is listed among platform features on the pricing page without a plan gate; IdP setup guides (Okta, Azure, Google Workspace) are custom OIDC/SAML apps, not catalogue apps. Users are added manually or via CSV import in Team management.

user_api.notes: The REST API's OAuth scopes cover payees, payments, invoices, payment terms, tax codes, GL accounts, custom fields and payer entities; none cover Tipalti Hub users or roles.

okta.notes: No OIN page (okta.com/integrations/tipalti/ returns 404); Tipalti's guide sets up a custom OIDC app.

entra.notes: Custom app registration (OIDC); no Entra Learn tutorial for Tipalti.
